1. Disconnect the vehicle's battery to prevent electrical shock or damage.  
2. Remove the protective control box cover using the appropriate tools, typically a socket wrench or screwdriver.  
3. Disconnect all wiring harnesses and sensors connected to the control box, noting their positions for reassembly.  
4. Loosen and remove mounting bolts or fasteners securing the control box to the vehicle frame or chassis.  
5. Carefully pull the control box out of its mounting location.  

For installation:  
1. Position the new protective control box in the same location as the removed unit.  
2. Secure it with the original mounting bolts and tighten to specification.  
3. Reconnect all wiring harnesses and sensors, ensuring proper alignment and secure connections.  
4. Reconnect the vehicle battery.  
5. Perform a system check to verify proper operation of the control box and associated systems.  

Note: Specific procedures may vary slightly depending on the exact model and configuration of the M998-series vehicle.
